summaries.day1: Step into the heart of the city with a start that will leave you in awe of Ancient Rome's grandeur.
summaries.day2: A day full of the Vatican's sacred art treasures and the majesty of St. Peter's awaits you.
summaries.day3: A delightful day of discovery among Baroque Rome's piazzas and hidden corners.
summaries.day4: A peaceful farewell to Rome, with park views and final flavor stops.

d1-panificio.title: Panificio Forno (Bakery & Pizza al Taglio)
d1-panificio.desc: Experience Rome's famous pizza al taglio (pizza by the slice). Pick up fresh slices from this affordable bakery near the Colosseum for a quick, tasty lunch. There are usually several varieties — try the most popular ones.

d1-oppio.title: Parco del Colle Oppio (Oppian Hill Park)
d1-oppio.desc: Stroll through this park for a breathtaking panoramic view of the Colosseum. Visit early to avoid the crowds and catch a peaceful photo — the hill's elevation offers wonderful angles.

d1-colosseo.title: Colosseum and the Arch of Constantine
d1-colosseo.desc: Admire the exterior of the Colosseum, symbol of the Roman Empire, and the details of the Arch of Constantine. On a tighter budget, take in the scale and grandeur of these ancient structures from the outside and snap plenty of photos. Soak up the atmosphere of the surrounding piazza.

d1-venezia.title: Piazza Venezia and the Altare della Patria
d1-venezia.desc: See one of Rome's central squares, Piazza Venezia, and the imposing monument that symbolizes Italy's unification, from the outside. Enjoy free views of the city from the monument's terraces and take some great photos — note that sitting on the steps is sometimes prohibited.

d1-trevi.title: Trevi Fountain
d1-trevi.desc: Witness the mesmerizing beauty of the world-famous Trevi Fountain. Toss a coin over your shoulder for the traditional wish to return to Rome — it can get crowded, so try different angles for the best photos.

d1-monti.title: Pasta Chef - Monti (Trattoria)
d1-monti.desc: Try affordable, fresh handmade pasta at this small trattoria loved by locals. Don't miss the daily specials, and expect generous portions. Arriving early makes it easier to find a table.

d2-vatikan.title: Vatican Museums and the Sistine Chapel
d2-vatikan.desc: See the Sistine Chapel, famous for Michelangelo's ceiling frescoes, inside the Vatican Museums — home to one of the richest art collections in the world. Book your ticket online in advance to skip the long queues.

d2-pizzarium.title: Pizzarium Bonci (Pizza by the Slice)
d2-pizzarium.desc: Taste an array of fresh pizza sold by weight at what's considered one of Rome's best slice shops. Ideal for a quick, satisfying lunch on the go.

d2-sanpietro.title: St. Peter's Basilica (outer piazza)
d2-sanpietro.desc: Wander through St. Peter's Square, ringed by Bernini's magnificent colonnade, and admire the basilica's striking façade for free. Climbing the dome carries a separate fee.

d2-castel.title: Castel Sant'Angelo (exterior)
d2-castel.desc: See the striking architecture of this cylindrical fortress on the banks of the Tiber from the outside. The nearby bridge offers great photos of the river and the castle.

d2-ponte.title: Ponte Sant'Angelo (Bridge of Angels)
d2-ponte.desc: Walk across this historic pedestrian bridge, adorned with Bernini's angel statues. Sunset brings the best views and photo angles.

d2-trastevere.title: Evening Stroll in Trastevere
d2-trastevere.desc: Soak up the evening atmosphere in the narrow, cobblestoned streets of Trastevere, Rome's liveliest and most colorful neighborhood. Worth exploring for its street musicians and cozy atmosphere.

d2-enzo.title: Da Enzo al 29 (Trattoria)
d2-enzo.desc: Taste classic Roman cuisine at this beloved little Trastevere eatery. Cacio e pepe and carbonara are among the favorites — we recommend arriving early to get a table.

d3-navona.title: Piazza Navona
d3-navona.desc: Sip your morning coffee in this grand Baroque piazza, home to Bernini's famous Fountain of the Four Rivers. One of Rome's liveliest squares, with street artists and historic façades.

d3-pantheon.title: Pantheon
d3-pantheon.desc: Marvel at the massive dome and oculus of the Pantheon, one of the best-preserved buildings of the ancient world. This engineering wonder can be visited for free today.

d3-eustachio.title: Sant'Eustachio Il Caffè
d3-eustachio.desc: Try one of the city's best espressos at this legendary Roman coffeehouse. Its frothy coffee, made with a secret recipe, is a must-taste.

d3-campodefiori.title: Campo de' Fiori Market
d3-campodefiori.desc: Browse fresh produce, spices, and local goods at this square, which turns into a lively open-air market each morning. The colorful stalls make for great photos.

d3-farnese.title: Palazzo Farnese (exterior)
d3-farnese.desc: Admire the façade of this magnificent palace, a masterpiece of Renaissance architecture, from the outside. Today home to the French Embassy, it lends elegance to the square.

d3-roscioli.title: Roscioli Salumeria (Dinner)
d3-roscioli.desc: Taste exquisite Italian cheeses, cured meats, and superb pasta at this famous deli-and-restaurant combo. Reservations are strongly recommended.

d4-borghese-gardens.title: Villa Borghese Gardens
d4-borghese-gardens.desc: Take a morning walk in one of Rome's largest parks, relax by the lake, or rent a bike. An ideal, peaceful start away from the city's bustle.

d4-galleria.title: Galleria Borghese
d4-galleria.desc: Enjoy masterpieces by Bernini and Caravaggio at this elegant gallery. Visitor numbers are limited, so be sure to book your ticket in advance.

d4-gelateria.title: Gelateria La Romana (Ice Cream)
d4-gelateria.desc: Try the rich variety of handmade Italian gelato at this legendary ice cream shop, serving since 1947. A refreshing break on a hot August day.

d4-popolo.title: Piazza del Popolo
d4-popolo.desc: Take your last photos at this expansive square, famous for its twin churches and the Egyptian obelisk at its center. Enjoy panoramic city views from the Pincio Terrace.

d4-margutta.title: Il Margutta (Dinner)
d4-margutta.desc: Enjoy your last dinner in Rome at this stylish vegetarian restaurant set in an art-gallery atmosphere. A special choice for a farewell, with creative presentation and a warm ambience.

transport.title: Getting Around
transport.body: Rome's historic center is protected by a Limited Traffic Zone (ZTL); driving into these areas carries heavy fines. Leave your car in a paid car park outside the ZTL (e.g. Parcheggio Esquilino or Parcheggio Via Veneto near Termini) and reach the center by public transport or on foot. A car comes in handy for day trips outside the city, like Tivoli — research parking at your destination in advance. Public transport can be the better option during morning and evening rush hour (7:30–9:30 and 17:30–19:30). Always confirm whether your hotel has parking when you book.

culture.title: Local Culture
culture.body: Tipping (mancia) isn't mandatory in restaurants, but it's appreciated for good service — typically 5–10%. When visiting churches and religious sites, keep your shoulders and knees covered; carrying a light shawl can help. It's common to greet people with 'Buongiorno' (good day) or 'Buonasera' (good evening). Drinking coffee standing at the counter is cheaper than sitting down — a local custom known as 'al banco'.

tips.title: Good to Know
tips.body: You can get free, clean drinking water from Rome's public fountains, known as 'nasoni' — bring a bottle. Type C, F, and L plugs are used, so pack a universal adapter. Watch out for pickpockets in the city center, especially in crowded tourist spots and on public transport. Wear comfortable walking shoes, as you'll be covering a lot of ground at an active pace. August runs hot, so don't forget sunscreen and a hat.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to what's on your mind. Can't find it? Just write to us.

items.a: Travyon is an AI-powered, personalized travel planning platform. Based on your budget, date range and travel style, it creates a day-by-day optimized plan in minutes.

items.q: Can I use it for free?
items.a: Yes. During beta, plan creation, interactive maps, and saved plans are free with no plan limit.

items.q: Do I have to create an account?
items.a: An account is required to create and save plans. Signing up takes only a few seconds and is completely free.

items.q: How long does it take to create a plan?
items.a: 15–30 seconds on average. The AI analyzes your preferences and instantly prepares a geographically optimized, day-by-day plan.
50+ popular cities worldwide are supported, and the list keeps growing. We cover popular destinations like Istanbul, Paris, Tokyo, Rome, Barcelona and New York.
Of course! Once your plan is created you can edit every activity, time and route however you like. The plan is entirely under your control.

items.q: Can I save more than one plan?
items.a: Yes. During beta you can save multiple plans without a limit and access them under "My Plans".
Connections are protected with HTTPS/TLS, and the app never stores passwords in plain text. Providers listed in the privacy policy support planning, maps, email, and diagnostics.
Yes, you can permanently delete your account and all your data from Settings > Account.
We currently run as a web app. A mobile app (iOS & Android) is coming soon — you can sign up to be notified.
It runs smoothly on up-to-date versions of Chrome, Firefox, Safari and Edge. Chrome is recommended for the best experience.

items.q: Do I need an internet connection?
items.a: An internet connection is required to create plans and view maps. Offline support for viewing saved plans is coming soon.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: We transparently explain how we protect and use your data.
privacy.intro: At Travyon ("we", "our"), we respect your privacy and take the protection of your personal data seriously. This Privacy Policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, and how we protect it when you use our services.

sections.title: 1. Data We Collect
sections.content:
To provide our services, we may process the following personal data:

• Account information: Name, email address, and profile photo. Passwords are handled by Firebase Authentication; the Travyon app cannot read or store them in plain text.
• Usage data: The plans you create, preferences, travel dates, and budget information.
• Security/diagnostic data: IP address, browser information, App Check signals, and technical error data when you consent.
• Communication data: Information you share when submitting a support request or feedback.

If you sign in with Google, Google shares basic profile information such as your name and email address with us.

sections.title: 2. Purpose of Data Use
sections.content:
We use the data we collect only for the following purposes:

• Creating and managing your account.
• Creating, saving and personalizing travel plans.
• Ensuring service security and preventing fraud.
• Improving app performance and user experience.
• Providing support when you request it.
• Fulfilling legal obligations.

sections.title: 3. Data Security
sections.content:
We protect personal data with access-controlled Firebase services, App Check, server-side validation, and HTTPS/TLS. Data in Firebase benefits from the infrastructure provider's protections in transit and at rest. Passwords are never stored in plain text by the app.

However, no transmission over the internet can be guaranteed to be 100% secure.

sections.title: 4. Data Sharing
sections.content:
We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal data. We may share data only in these cases:

• Service providers: Google Firebase (identity, storage, and server functions), Google Maps API (maps), Google Gemini AI (plan generation), Resend (email delivery), and—only when you consent—Sentry (technical error/diagnostic data). Only the data needed for the relevant function is transferred.
• Legal requirement: Pursuant to a court order or legal obligation.
• Corporate transactions: In a merger or acquisition, with assurances that the data remains protected.

sections.title: 5. Cookies
sections.content:
Our site uses cookies/local storage for sessions, local plans, and preferences. The types we use:

• Essential: Required for session management and security.
• Preference: Remembers language, theme, and app settings.
• Optional diagnostics: Used to track technical errors only when you consent in Settings.

We do not use advertising tracking. Disabling browser storage may affect some features.

sections.title: 6. Your Rights
sections.content:
Under applicable data protection law, you have the following rights:

• The right to learn whether your personal data is being processed.
• The right to request information about processed data.
• The right to request correction or deletion of your data.
• The right to object to the processing of your data.
• The right to data portability.

You can exercise these rights by emailing us at iletisim@travyon.app.

sections.title: 7. Data Retention
sections.content: We retain your data for as long as your account is active. If you delete your account, we permanently delete your personal data from our systems within 30 days. Some data may be retained longer where required by legal obligations.

sections.title: 8. Changes
sections.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you at your registered email address if there are significant changes. You can always find the current version of the policy on this page.

sections.title: 9. Contact
sections.content:
For questions about privacy:

Address: Istanbul, Türkiye

sections.title: 10. reCAPTCHA Protection
sections.content: This site is protected by Google reCAPTCHA to prevent abuse and automated (bot) traffic. Use of reCAPTCHA is subject to the Google Privacy Policy (https://policies.google.com/privacy) and Terms of Service (https://policies.google.com/terms).

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.subtitle: The rules and responsibilities that apply while using Travyon.
terms.intro: These Terms of Use govern your use of the Travyon platform (the "Service"). Please read these terms carefully before using the platform.

sections.title: 1. Acceptance
sections.content:
By using Travyon (the "Platform"), you confirm that you have read, understood and agree to these Terms of Use. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use the platform.

Users under the age of 18 should only use the platform under the supervision of a parent or legal guardian.

sections.title: 2. Description of Service
sections.content:
Travyon is a web platform that creates personalized travel plans using artificial intelligence technology. Our services include:

• AI-powered travel plan generation
• Interactive map and route viewing
• Saving and managing plans
• Community features and plan sharing
• Weather and travel duration information

The scope of our services may be changed with prior notice.

sections.title: 3. Account Creation and Security
sections.content:
• You must register with a valid email address to use the platform.
• You are responsible for keeping your account information accurate and up to date.
• You are responsible for the security of your account. Do not share your password with anyone.
• You must notify us immediately if you notice unauthorized use of your account.
• Each user may only open one account.

sections.title: 4. Acceptable Use
sections.content:
By using the platform, you agree to the following rules:

✓ You will only use the platform for lawful purposes.
✓ You will respect the rights of others.
✓ You will share accurate and truthful information.

✗ You will not use the platform to distribute malicious software.
✗ You will not share content that harms other users.
✗ You will not take actions that overload the platform's infrastructure.
✗ You will not scrape data using automated tools (bots, scrapers, etc.).
✗ You will not attempt to gain unauthorized access to other users' accounts.

sections.title: 5. Intellectual Property
sections.content:
All content, design, code, logos and brand elements on the platform belong to Travyon and are protected by intellectual property law.

The content of travel plans you create on the platform belongs to you. However, by creating them you grant us a license to store and process these plans on the platform.

You must obtain prior written permission to copy, distribute or use any part of the platform for commercial purposes.

sections.title: 6. Paid Plans
sections.content:
Payment terms applicable to the Pro plan:

• The subscription is billed monthly and renews automatically.
• If you cancel, you will not be charged at the next renewal date; your Pro access continues until the end of the period you already paid for.
• Refund requests are not automatic: contact us via the Contact form within the first 14 days to request a refund; requests are reviewed manually.
• Prices may change with prior notice. Existing subscribers are notified at least 30 days in advance.
• Payments are processed through iyzico's secure payment infrastructure; your card details are never stored on our servers.

sections.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
sections.content:
Travyon makes no guarantee regarding the accuracy or completeness of travel plans generated by artificial intelligence. Plans are advisory in nature; final decisions belong to the user.

Travyon cannot be held responsible for:
• Trip cancellations, delays or unforeseen circumstances
• Actions of third-party service providers (hotels, airlines, etc.)
• Incorrect information generated by artificial intelligence
• Damages arising from the platform's temporary unavailability

sections.title: 8. Account Termination
sections.content:
You can delete your account at any time from Settings > Account.

We reserve the right to suspend or close your account without prior notice if you are found to have violated these Terms of Use. Refunds are not issued for serious violations.

sections.title: 9. Governing Law
sections.content: These Terms of Use are governed by the laws of the Republic of Türkiye. Istanbul Courts and Enforcement Offices have jurisdiction over any disputes.

sections.content: We may update these terms from time to time. We will notify you at your registered email address of significant changes. Continuing to use the platform after a change means you accept the new terms.

items.q: What is the plan creation limit?
items.a: During beta, you can create unlimited plans on the Free tier. Pro features will be announced before launch.

items.q: How does the AI prepare my plan?
items.a: The destination, dates, budget, and preferences you enter are analyzed with Gemini AI to create a personalized plan.

items.q: Can I share my plans with others?
items.a: Yes, you can share the plans you create with the community or via a link.

items.q: How can I delete my data?
items.a: You can permanently remove all your data from the "My Data → Delete Account" section.
